notes: melodee's page consumes WebMIDI directly (index.html midiOn()): notes pass through to the firmware synth; CC 20..26 = knob roles 0..6 via worklet.js midiKnob() (abs mode computes value - last, which digests the controller's relative 64+-n encoding natively); CC 27 = MASTER (0..127 -> 0..1023). The page emits no MIDI out, so LED feedback is mirror-echo only. With the controller firmware compiled with this map, NO shim is needed: enable the page's knobson option (mode=abs) and play.
